home.seoDescription: Build surveys with Porsnama, collect responses and turn data into decisions. A Persian survey builder with conditional logic, publishing and analysis.
home.faq.signinQuestion: Do respondents need to sign in?
home.faq.signinAnswer: No. Published surveys are available through a public link or personal invitation. Respondents do not need a management account.
home.faq.rolesAnswer: After sign-in, your organisation membership determines the features you can access. Administrators manage members and roles, editors build surveys, and viewers access data and reports.
home.faq.publishedQuestion: Can I change a published survey?
home.faq.publishedAnswer: The published structure stays fixed so responses remain comparable. Create a new draft from it to make changes.
home.faq.exportsAnswer: Download responses as CSV or Excel and reports as PDF. Persian display and exports are supported.
product.heroDescription: Porsnama brings survey creation, publishing and analysis into a shared workspace. Design your questions, shape the response journey and share the results with your team.
product.typesDescription: 12 question types with appropriate settings and validation, from short answers to comparing multiple choices.
product.logicDescription: Display conditions, forward branching and answer piping keep surveys relevant. Hidden questions never prevent someone from completing a required field.

product.details.createDescription: Edit and duplicate sections and questions. Autosave and save status help preserve your changes.
product.details.shareTitle: Bring your survey to its audience.
product.details.shareDescription: Public links, QR codes and personal invitations with response availability dates. Email delivery requires your organisation’s email service configuration.
product.details.analyseDescription: Counts, charts, averages, NPS and date filters alongside CSV, Excel and Persian PDF exports.
product.details.rolesTitle: A clear role for every account.
product.details.rolesDescription: Administrator, editor and viewer roles, organisation separation, change history and webhook integration.
product.seoDescription: Porsnama brings a Persian survey builder, conditional logic, publishing, response analysis and organisation roles together.
about.heroEnd: And its power to change things.
about.letterFirst: Porsnama is being built to close the distance between asking, listening and deciding. We want teams to express their questions clearly and bring people’s answers together in an understandable way.
about.letterSecond: From a small research project to customer feedback and colleague experiences, our goal is the same: tools should support the conversation and make work easier.
about.letterThird: Porsnama combines the Persian words for question and view. We begin with a question to create a clearer picture of people’s perspectives.
about.clarityDescription: Questions, journeys and reports should be easy to understand. Better choices begin with clear tools.
about.respectDescription: A Persian and mobile experience with relevant questions respects people’s time and attention.
about.accessDescription: Each organisation’s data stays within its own scope, and account roles determine access.
